theorem partialZ_pullback {h b : ℝ} {f : InnerProfile}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) {p : PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (inner h p)) :
    partialZ (pullback h b f) p = pullback h (b - D h) (Z h b f) p
